2// NOTE: this is a vendored and intentionally pruned subset of upstream
3// self_cell, kept to the API surface MiniJinja currently needs.
4
5//! Minimal, vendored subset of `self_cell` used by MiniJinja.
6//!
7//! We only keep the functionality that is currently exercised in this crate:
8//! `try_new`, `borrow_dependent` (covariant cells), and `with_dependent_mut`.
9
10#[doc(hidden)]
11pub(crate) extern crate alloc;
12
13#[doc(hidden)]
14pub(crate) mod unsafe_self_cell;
15
16/// Declares a self-referential struct with the subset MiniJinja uses.
17///
18/// Generated API:
19///
20/// ```ignore
21/// fn try_new<Err>(
22///     owner: $Owner,
23///     dependent_builder: impl for<'a> FnOnce(&'a $Owner) -> Result<$Dependent<'a>, Err>
24/// ) -> Result<Self, Err>
25///
26/// fn borrow_dependent<'a>(&'a self) -> &'a $Dependent<'a> // covariant only
27///
28/// fn with_dependent_mut<'outer_fn, Ret>(
29///     &'outer_fn mut self,
30///     func: impl for<'a> FnOnce(&'a $Owner, &'outer_fn mut $Dependent<'a>) -> Ret
31/// ) -> Ret
32/// ```
33///
34macro_rules! self_cell {
35(
36    $(#[$StructMeta:meta])*
37    $Vis:vis struct $StructName:ident $(<$OwnerLifetime:lifetime>)? {
38        owner: $Owner:ty,
39
40
41        #[covariant]
42        dependent: $Dependent:ident,
43    }
44) => {
45    #[repr(transparent)]
46    $(#[$StructMeta])*
47    $Vis struct $StructName $(<$OwnerLifetime>)? {
48        unsafe_self_cell: $crate::vendor::self_cell::unsafe_self_cell::UnsafeSelfCell<
49            $StructName$(<$OwnerLifetime>)?,
50            $Owner,
51            $Dependent<'static>
52        >,
53
54        $(owner_marker: ::core::marker::PhantomData<&$OwnerLifetime ()> ,)?
55    }
56
57    #[allow(dead_code)]
58    impl <$($OwnerLifetime)?> $StructName <$($OwnerLifetime)?> {
59        $crate::vendor::self_cell::_self_cell_try_new!($Vis, $Owner $(=> $OwnerLifetime)?, $Dependent);
60
61        /// Calls given closure `func` with an unique reference to dependent.
62        $Vis fn with_dependent_mut<'outer_fn, Ret>(
63            &'outer_fn mut self,
64            func: impl for<'_q> ::core::ops::FnOnce(&'_q $Owner, &'outer_fn mut $Dependent<'_q>) -> Ret
65        ) -> Ret {
66            let (owner, dependent) = unsafe {
67                    self.unsafe_self_cell.borrow_mut()
68            };
69
70            func(owner, dependent)
71        }
72
73        /// Borrows dependent.
74        $Vis fn borrow_dependent<'_q>(&'_q self) -> &'_q $Dependent<'_q> {
75            fn _assert_covariance<'x: 'y, 'y>(x: &'y $Dependent<'x>) -> &'y $Dependent<'y> {
76                x
77            }
78
79            unsafe { self.unsafe_self_cell.borrow_dependent() }
80        }
81    }
82
83    impl $(<$OwnerLifetime>)? Drop for $StructName $(<$OwnerLifetime>)? {
84        fn drop(&mut self) {
85            unsafe {
86                self.unsafe_self_cell.drop_joined::<$Dependent>();
87            }
88        }
89    }
90
91};
92}
93
94#[doc(hidden)]
95macro_rules! _self_cell_try_new {
96    ($Vis:vis, $Owner:ty $(=> $OwnerLifetime:lifetime)?, $Dependent:ident) => {
97        /// Constructs a new self-referential struct or returns an error.
98        ///
99        /// Consumes owner on error.
100        $Vis fn try_new<Err>(
101            owner: $Owner,
102            dependent_builder:
103                impl for<'_q> ::core::ops::FnOnce(&'_q $Owner) -> ::core::result::Result<$Dependent<'_q>, Err>
104        ) -> ::core::result::Result<Self, Err> {
105            type JoinedCell<'_q $(, $OwnerLifetime)?> =
106                    $crate::vendor::self_cell::unsafe_self_cell::JoinedCell<$Owner, $Dependent<'_q>>;
107
108            // unsafe placed here to make sure the body macro can't be abused.
109            unsafe {
110                $crate::vendor::self_cell::_self_cell_try_new_body!(JoinedCell, owner $(=> $OwnerLifetime)?, dependent_builder)
111            }
112        }
113    };
114}
115
116#[doc(hidden)]
117macro_rules! _self_cell_try_new_body {
118    ($JoinedCell:ty, $owner:expr $(=> $OwnerLifetime:lifetime)?, $dependent_builder:expr) => {{
119        // Allocate and initialize the owner/dependent pair in one cell.
120
121        let layout = $crate::vendor::self_cell::alloc::alloc::Layout::new::<$JoinedCell>();
122        assert!(layout.size() != 0);
123
124        let joined_void_ptr = ::core::ptr::NonNull::new($crate::vendor::self_cell::alloc::alloc::alloc(layout)).unwrap();
125
126        let joined_ptr = joined_void_ptr.cast::<$JoinedCell>();
127
128        let (owner_ptr, dependent_ptr) = <$JoinedCell>::_field_pointers(joined_ptr.as_ptr());
129
130        // Move owner into newly allocated space.
131        owner_ptr.write($owner);
132
133        // Drop guard that cleans up should building the dependent panic.
134        let drop_guard =
135            $crate::vendor::self_cell::unsafe_self_cell::OwnerAndCellDropGuard::new(joined_ptr);
136
137        match $dependent_builder(&*owner_ptr) {
138            ::core::result::Result::Ok(dependent) => {
139                dependent_ptr.write(dependent);
140                ::core::mem::forget(drop_guard);
141
142                ::core::result::Result::Ok(Self {
143                    unsafe_self_cell: $crate::vendor::self_cell::unsafe_self_cell::UnsafeSelfCell::new(
144                        joined_void_ptr,
145                    ),
146                    $(owner_marker: ::core::marker::PhantomData::<&$OwnerLifetime ()> ,)?
147                })
148            }
149            ::core::result::Result::Err(err) => ::core::result::Result::Err(err)
150        }
151    }}
152}
153
154pub(crate) use _self_cell_try_new;
155pub(crate) use _self_cell_try_new_body;
156pub(crate) use self_cell;
